description: Every playable footprint inside the owner-accepted boundary has exactly one district. The 508-row audit table is the required set. Four extra county footprints whose centroids also fall inside the polygon are included so the runtime set has no unowned building.

A.name: Town Square
A.summary: Plaza and the mixed-use buildings around it, including the Helen Heneghan turret block and the Cambria tower.

B.name: Hungerford Corridor
B.summary: Northern commercial corridor, both sides of Hungerford Drive inside the playable boundary.

C.name: Regal and Courthouse
C.summary: Regal and the East Montgomery colonnade, Maryland Avenue, Courthouse Square, the historic courthouse, Circuit Court, District Court, and the Executive Office Building.

D.name: Rockville Pike and Metro
D.summary: Remaining southern and eastern development, the Metro station, parking structures, and the pedestrian bridge.
